title: Document/workspace symbols, folding, semantic tokens
description: Outline groups rules under their head term; workspace symbol search by term/type/rule name. Folding per top-level form. Semantic tokens for terms, types, variables, literals, priorities.
acceptance_criteria: symbols and semantic fixtures pass.

title: Inlay hints for pattern binding types
description: Show inferred type after each bound variable in patterns and let/if-let bindings (e.g. x: Value, c: Imm64), plus argument-name hints if available.
acceptance_criteria: inlay fixtures pass.

title: Context-aware completion and signature help
description: LHS pattern position offers only terms with extractors; RHS/if-let expr position offers constructors, filtered by expected type where known, with snippet tab stops for arguments. Also types, variants, in-scope variables, top-level keywords. Signature help inside term applications highlights current argument.
acceptance_criteria: completion and signature fixtures pass; LHS never offers constructor-only terms.

title: Hover
description: Term: signature, kind (constructor/extractor/internal/external), doc comment, count of rules matching on it. Type: definition and variants. Variable: inferred type and where it is bound.
acceptance_criteria: hover fixtures pass.

title: Go to definition, references, rename, document highlight
description: Terms, types, variants, named rules, variables. Rename rejects clashes and cross-kind renames, works across the project set.
acceptance_criteria: navigation fixtures pass.

title: Symbol resolution index
description: Build a definition/reference index over the project set for terms, types, enum variants, rules (named), and pattern/let variables with scoping. Shared by navigation, hover, rename, highlight, completion.
acceptance_criteria: Resolve fixtures covering shadowing, extractors vs constructors, cross-file terms.

title: Diagnostics: syntax, sema, type errors
description: Layered like clif-lsp: (1) our tolerant syntax errors, (2) run cranelift-isle lexer/parser/sema over the project set and map its Error variants (with Pos) to LSP diagnostics, including undefined terms/types, arity, type mismatches, unused/unbound vars. Later layers only run when earlier are clean. Hint diagnostics for unused decls.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures per error class under tests/fixtures/diagnostics.
close_reason: Syntax layer + cranelift-isle sema/overlap/recursion layers over the project set, published per file; unused-decl hints split into a follow-up

title: Overlap error diagnostics with related locations
description: Run cranelift-isle overlap::check and present each overlap error as a diagnostic on both rules with relatedInformation, naming the priority that would resolve it. Quick fix: insert (rule N ...) priority. Overlap errors are the most confusing ISLE error today.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture with two overlapping rules shows diagnostics on both and a priority quick fix.

title: Project file set configuration
description: ISLE files only make sense together (opts/*.isle with clif_opt.isle, prelude_opt.isle, prelude.isle). Support an isle-lsp.toml listing files, plus a sensible auto-detect (sibling .isle files / cranelift layout). Single-file fallback. Re-analyze the set when any member changes; open buffers override disk.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture with multi-file project resolves a term declared in another file.
close_reason: Project discovery (config, cranelift opt layout, siblings), open-buffer overlay, server wiring, project fixtures

title: Error-tolerant lexer and CST
description: cranelift-isle's parser stops at first error and its lexer drops comments, so write our own tolerant s-expression lexer/CST that keeps comments, spans, and recovers at paren boundaries so one error does not hide others. Reuse cranelift-isle Pos conventions for conversion. Top-level forms: pragma, type, decl, rule, extractor, extern, convert, spec/model if present in 0.136.2.
acceptance_criteria: Fixtures under tests/fixtures/parser for valid and broken input; no panics on arbitrary truncated input.
close_reason: Tolerant lexer/CST with recovery; tokens and syntax-tree fixtures; invariants harness

title: Project scaffold mirroring clif-lsp
description: Cargo.toml (lib + bin), lib.rs/main.rs, server.rs on tower-lsp-server 0.23, document.rs on ropey, tokio. Depend on crates.io cranelift-isle =0.136.2 (NOT the wasmtime path checkout) so the crate can be published. Mirror clif-lsp module layout: lexer, parser, syntax, resolve, document, navigation, hover, completion, diagnostics, etc. Add LICENSE files, README, docs/features.md skeleton.
acceptance_criteria: cargo build passes; server answers initialize and shutdown over stdio; cranelift-isle pinned to 0.136.2 in Cargo.toml.
close_reason: Scaffold builds; initialize/shutdown verified over stdio; cranelift-isle pinned =0.136.2

title: Filecheck fixture harness
description: Mirror clif-lsp/tests: tests/fixtures.rs with harness=false, filecheck 0.5, modes/queries embedded in .isle fixture comments (mode: ..., ^ caret queries), tests/fixtures/<area>/ directories, tools/update_filecheck.py, fixtures README. Fixture comments use ;; so ISLE lexer ignores them.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test --test fixtures runs and fails on a CHECK mismatch; one seed fixture per area as areas land.
close_reason: Harness runs .isle fixtures via filecheck; fails on mismatch; seeded document fixtures

title: Tier 1: core editing loop
description: Diagnostics, navigation, hover, completion, inlay hints, symbols for ISLE files. Must be solid before tier 2 or 3.

title: Generate filetest from a rule
description: Code action: instantiate the rule LHS as a CLIF function and emit a 'test optimize' filetest with the RHS as expected output. Confirm with upstream cranelift 0.136.2 egraph opts (we rely on upstream for pass-firing info; no path checkout).
acceptance_criteria: Generated test passes under cranelift-filetests for a simple simplify rule.

title: Heuristic lints for simplify rules
description: Warn on: RHS not cheaper than LHS, no-op rewrite, rule shadowed by higher-priority rule, possible rewrite loops between rules, missing commutative twin. Lints are heuristics, label them as such; each has a code and can be disabled in config.
acceptance_criteria: One fixture per lint, plus a negative fixture each.

title: Rules for this term
description: Custom request + code lens: from a term list every rule matching on it in priority order and which wins on overlap. Extend to 'which rules could match this CLIF snippet' by matching rule LHS shapes against opcodes/args.
acceptance_criteria: Fixture lists rules for iadd-like term in priority order.

title: Docs: features.md, requests.md, neovim.md, README
description: Mirror clif-lsp docs; document custom requests and editor setup.
acceptance_criteria: docs list every implemented feature.

title: Basic code actions
description: Add missing (decl ...) for an undefined term, remove unused decl, replace unknown term with closest name, add rule priority.
acceptance_criteria: actions fixtures pass.

title: Tier 2: rule-centric tooling
description: ISLE-specific features: rules-for-term lookup, filetest generation, lints. Depends on tier 1.

title: Unused declaration hints
description: Hint diagnostic (tag Unnecessary) for a decl that no rule, extractor, or other form uses. Needs the symbol index from the resolution bead; deferred out of the diagnostics bead.
acceptance_criteria: diagnostics fixture shows the hint; used and extern decls are not flagged.

title: Generate clif_opt.isle without a cranelift build
description: clif_opt.isle and numerics.isle are generated by cranelift-codegen-meta's build script, so projects built from crates.io source or without a prior build have no CLIF term decls. Investigate generating them via the cranelift-codegen-meta crate, or bundling a copy pinned to 0.136.2.
acceptance_criteria: design note; fixture where iadd resolves with no target/ dir.

title: Project detection for lowering backends
description: Project discovery only knows the mid-end opt layout. Add the lowering compilations from cranelift-codegen-meta isle.rs (prelude.isle, prelude_lower.isle, clif_lower.isle, numerics.isle plus src/isa/<arch>/ files) with fixtures.
acceptance_criteria: isa/x64-style tree resolves to its lowering set.

title: Generated Rust view for a term
description: Run cranelift-isle codegen for the project and show the generated function for the selected term, mapped back to rules.
acceptance_criteria: fixture.

title: Rule overlap and term call graph
description: Graph of terms (rules calling terms on the RHS) and rule overlaps; include recursion detection from cranelift-isle recursion.rs.
acceptance_criteria: fixture.

title: Decision trie view per term
description: Render cranelift-isle trie_again RuleSet for a term: test order, bindings, which rules each leaf reaches, why a rule is unreachable.
acceptance_criteria: fixture.

title: HTML output infrastructure
description: Port clif-lsp html.rs/view.rs approach: custom request returns a standalone HTML document; shared styling.
acceptance_criteria: request returns valid HTML; fixture CHECKs on content.

title: Commutative twin code action
description: When a rule on (iadd x (iconst c)) exists without its flipped twin, offer to generate it.
acceptance_criteria: action fixture.

title: Tier 3: HTML views
description: Decision trie, generated Rust, rule overlap graph, rendered like clif-lsp's html output.

title: Verify rule via veri
description: Code lens to run the cranelift veri crate on a rule using src/spec; report counterexamples as diagnostics. Investigate availability on crates.io first.
acceptance_criteria: design note and prototype.

title: Comment-preserving formatter
description: cranelift-isle printer drops comments, so write our own on the tolerant CST. Format document/range, idempotent.
acceptance_criteria: idempotence fixtures.

title: Later
description: Verification via veri, comment-preserving formatter.
